stage_boundaries.nativeA_ns: Packed core entry through nativeA map completion, including initial row-index array preparation
stage_boundaries.packB_ns: From nativeA completion through packB completion
stage_boundaries.tile_ns: Sum of complete per-row rowTiles Array.ofFn calls
stage_boundaries.output_ns: Sum of complete per-row RowOutput.row calls
stage_boundaries.native_dot_ns: NativeFinal.dotLoop calls within direct path; overlaps direct_ns
stage_boundaries.replay_ns: Complete replayEarly calls in either route; overlaps direct_ns/output_ns
stage_boundaries.residual_ns: BMM total minus the five disjoint stages; includes dispatch, row-loop bookkeeping, append and probe overhead

overhead_scope: Per-case best_ns against original uninstrumented binary, plus per-call timed/checksum/raw comparison against the same counter/output harness with internal clocks disabled. Sequential processes include process noise; controls do not establish official stage shares.
